example.title: Lincoln Highway, 3 mile segment south of Business I-80 and ALT 93: concrete bridge and double culvert

brief: Early 1920s Lincoln Highway drainage structures on an abandoned two-lane concrete/asphalt roadbed: a small reinforced-concrete box bridge (short slab span on vertical abutments) with a thin projecting slab edge and splayed concrete wing walls, and a double pipe culvert in a rubble-and-mortar headwall; a small concrete post marked 'N' stands by the road. Flat desert flats with distant mountains. Model the slab-span box with its splayed wings on the Tamarack highway.

traits.railing_detail: none; slab edge and low wing walls
